market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate in a range as rate fears (Bullock hawkish, 'higher for longer') offset global equity strength (AI rally, Nasdaq record). Oil below $100 pressures energy; iron ore weakness drags materials. Super inflows support financials. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and US political developments. ^AXJO likely 1-2% range-bound.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from China rebalancing and iron ore cycle peak weigh on mining. Housing correction in Sydney creates 12-18 month NPL overhang for banks. However, super policy reform, AUKUS spending, WA gold/critical minerals discovery, and domestic energy transition offer medium-term growth pockets. 'Bigger and poorer Australia' narrative suggests slower GDP growth, favouring value over growth.
